structures-identd-v1.attribute_6: This contains various types of payment-related identifiers available in the IDENTIFIERS file as ID TYPE. Available values are: BIC8, BIC11, LEI and all the national clearing codes. For the national codes the syntax is: 2-digit country code, dash (-), ID acronym, length of the ID. The ISO CLC TYPE is an equivalent of the ID TYPE, but is issued by ISO. Only a low number of ISO clearing code types exist today. For example, the ID TYPE "DE-BLZ8" corresponds to the ISO CLC "DEBLZ". For a cross-reference between the ISO CLC TYPE and the ID TYPE used in the IDENTIFIERS file, see the FORMATS file.

This key should not be linked however to the modification flags as in our files the record key is driving the additions (MODIFICATION TYPE “A”), deletions (MODIFICATION TYPE “D”) and modifications (MODIFICATION TYPE “M”).
